name: Improve the solution
decision: What can I change to improve my solution?

children.name: Change which models are in the ensemble
children.description: Add, multiply, or prune the set of models/checkpoints whose predictions are combined.
children.decision: Which models should the ensemble contain?

children.name: Add a structurally different model or input modality
children.description: Bring in a model family, backbone, input representation or data modality unlike the current members to add diversity.

children.name: Add more checkpoints, folds or seeds of the same model
children.description: Increase the count of same-recipe members (folds, seeds, snapshots, repeated runs) to reduce variance.

children.name: Select, swap or prune existing members/checkpoints
children.description: Choose the best subset of already-trained candidates, replace a weak member, or compare ensemble against a single model.

children.name: Change how predictions are combined
children.description: Alter the blending/aggregation mechanism of ensemble members.
children.decision: How should member predictions be combined?

children.name: Weighted blend of members
children.description: Combine members with hand- or search-set weights.
children.decision: How should blend weights be set?

children.name: Tune weights by search under a limited budget
children.description: Manually or automatically search weight values using leaderboard/validation feedback, with attention to step size, trial budget and overfitting.

children.name: Weight members by estimated quality instead of equally
children.description: Give stronger/dominant members more weight, or test equal vs. non-uniform weighting.

children.name: Re-set weights after adding or changing a member
children.description: Assign or re-tune the weight of a newly added/changed component and check previously tuned weights remain valid.

children.name: Rank-transform or rescale predictions before combining
children.description: Convert to ranks, normalise or rescale predictions before averaging, esp. for rank-based metrics.

children.name: Train a stacking meta-learner
children.description: Fit a second-level model on base-model (out-of-fold) predictions, possibly with extra features.

children.name: Change cross-validation fold aggregation
children.description: Decide how fold models' predictions are averaged: all folds vs. best single fold, fold-level or non-uniform weighting.

children.name: Change the model or its training
children.description: Modify the learner itself: backbone, architecture, hyperparameters, loss, augmentation.
children.decision: Which part of the model or its training should change?

children.name: Swap or resize the pretrained backbone
children.description: Replace the backbone/pretrained model with a different family or a larger/smaller variant.

children.name: Modify architecture, head, or multi-input fusion
children.description: Change attention blocks, classification head, capacity, or how multiple input branches are fused/dropped.

children.name: Tune gradient-boosted tree settings or library
children.description: Change boosting type, depth, leaves, regularisation, rounds or switch tree library.

children.name: Tune neural optimisation hyperparameters
children.description: Change learning rate, epochs, batch size, regularisation, early stopping, fine-tuning schedule.

children.name: Align loss/objective/target with the metric
children.description: Use a custom loss, early-stopping metric or target transformation matching the evaluation metric.

children.name: Add training augmentation or pseudo-labeling
children.description: Use mixup, other augmentation, pseudo-labels or sampling strategies in training.

children.name: Change the data or features
children.description: Alter what the model sees: features, input representation, training data.
children.decision: What data or features should change?

children.name: Add engineered features
children.description: Create aggregation, text-statistic, embedding, metadata or date-derived features.

children.name: Remove or select features
children.description: Drop noisy/unimportant feature groups or choose how many top-ranked features to keep.

children.name: Change the input representation or preprocessing
children.description: Alter how raw inputs are represented and preprocessed before modelling.
children.decision: What aspect of the input pipeline should change?

children.name: Change input representation, resolution or channels
children.description: Modify image size, spectrogram parameters, derived channels, windows, reshaping.

children.name: Change preprocessing, normalisation or filtering
children.description: Adjust normalisation statistics, filters, tokenisation, text cleaning or preprocessing order.

children.name: Change the training set
children.description: Add external data, restrict to a matching subset, remove noisy or duplicate samples.

children.name: Change validation and evaluation practice
children.description: Alter splits or how much to trust validation/leaderboard signals.
children.decision: What should change about validation and evaluation?

children.name: Change the split scheme or fold count
children.description: Choose CV splitter (stratified/group), number of folds, or handling of distribution-mismatched subsets.

children.name: Calibrate trust in validation/leaderboard signals
children.description: Quantify noise, non-determinism and local-vs-leaderboard agreement before acting on small differences.

children.name: Change inference-time behaviour and post-processing
children.description: Modify test-time procedures or transform predictions after the model.
children.decision: What should change at inference or after prediction?

children.name: Apply test-time augmentation
children.description: Average predictions over flips/crops/stochastic augmentations at inference.

children.name: Post-process predictions
children.description: Transform final predictions to suit the metric.
children.decision: What kind of post-processing should be applied?

children.name: Tune thresholds, rounding or binning
children.description: Discretise continuous predictions with tuned cutpoints.

children.name: Apply other post-processing rules
children.description: Clipping, bias correction, rule-based or column-specific adjustments.

children.name: Improve the experiment process
children.description: Debug, protect against regressions, design experiments and manage resources.
children.decision: What process problem is blocking progress?

children.name: Prevent or detect pipeline integrity problems
children.description: Find silent bugs and manage artifacts.

children.name: Check data, shape and alignment bugs
children.description: Verify inputs, row order, shapes, silent argument and aggregation errors.

children.name: Manage checkpoints, files and environment
children.description: Control paths, model files, platform/device and library issues when swapping artifacts.

children.name: Handle a score regression
children.description: React to a score drop after a change.
children.decision: What should be done after a regression?

children.name: Isolate the cause
children.description: Revert/ablate components one at a time to find the culprit.

children.name: Recover and move on
children.description: Restore the best prior state, restructure or retry the change more carefully.

children.name: Design experiments and stopping rules
children.description: Change one thing at a time, set iteration budgets, decide when a lever is exhausted.

children.name: Manage compute, memory and runtime
children.description: Reduce memory/time, cache, or make pipelines faster and reproducible.
